title: W9 F5 -- Do not reset a saved added font when the added-font list failed to load
description: Follow-up found by reviewer agent-23c2 while approving T281 (same kind of bug). src/fonts/registry.ts about line 73: a FAILED added-font (user font) list is treated as 'no added fonts'; if the installed list then loads, a saved ADDED font is reset to Futura for good. Fix: when the added-font list failed to load, skip the reset; reset only when both lists really loaded and the font is in neither. Keep the folio.* key and signatures. Smallest change. Fail-first: one new unit test in src/fonts/registry.test.ts (added-font list rejects, installed list loads without the font: saved choice kept), shown failing before the fix, output in notes/F5-fail-first.txt. Verify: npx vitest run src/fonts; npx tsc -b. No browser run needed (T281's ran on the same code path; the validation rerun covers it). Write notes/F5.md. No commits.

review.note: Approved (agent-23c2). registry.ts initFonts: addedFailed flag set only when listUserFonts rejects; reset = selected!==saved && installed.length>0 && !addedFailed, so the saved choice is reset only when both lists loaded and the font is in neither. The saved font is still applied before any await; the folio.workspace.interfaceFont key and the initFonts signature are unchanged; the T281 tests still pass. The new test (added list rejects, installed ['Georgia'], saved Menlo kept, key and --ui-font) failed before the fix (F5-fail-first.txt, 1 failed of 7). Rerun: npx vitest run src/fonts 29/29 passed; npx tsc -b exit 0 (log node_modules/.cache/personal-word-beta/r4-23c2/T283-unit.log). No browser run, as the work order says.
